description: This file defines the PurgeEmployeeModel class within the OrangeHRM system, which implements the Normalizable interface to provide a serializable representation of a purged employee, identified by employee number. It is part of the Maintenance API module.

classes.name: PurgeEmployeeModel
classes.description: Represents a model for purging employee data, serializable to a standard array format for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PurgeEmployeeModel with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model data into an associative array suitable for API serialization.
